subject.title: Control UI chat markdown only renders data URI images, not remote https image URLs

question: Should Control UI render remote http/https Markdown image URLs directly from chat content, and under what trust policy?
rationale: Current code, tests, docs, and merged hardening intentionally prevent arbitrary remote browser image fetches, while the requested UX improvement changes that security boundary.

options.title: Keep No-Remote Default
options.body: Preserve same-origin/data/blob image loading and require structured same-origin media, blob-backed fetches, or an explicit opt-in/proxy design before remote images render.

options.title: Allow Direct Remote Images
options.body: Accept the browser-fetch privacy tradeoff and update the renderer, sanitizer attributes, CSP, docs, tests, and real Control UI proof together.

options.title: Fold Into Inline Media Umbrella
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/64607 for the broader media policy and keep this issue linked as the focused remote Markdown image slice.

recommendation.title: Keep No-Remote Default
recommendation.body: Preserve same-origin/data/blob image loading and require structured same-origin media, blob-backed fetches, or an explicit opt-in/proxy design before remote images render.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved choice is closest to the Control UI browser-fetch and CSP security policy changed in that merged history.
